info.title: FGC Operations REST API
info.description: Generated from implemented route catalog and request schemas. Response envelope and receipts are specified here; concrete read DTOs remain in @fgc/contracts. Internal worker/health endpoints are not public business API.

patch.description: Client DTOs are defined in @fgc/contracts. Business constraints and current-session authorization also run transactionally in SQL. Refinements that involve multiple fields are enforced at runtime.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse exactly the same normalized request for a manual retry. Reauthorize before replay. No automatic retries.

200.description: Immutable receipt only; query current entity separately.
